pages.text: $(#c88ce0)【Befuddlement】$()$(br2)When it hits you or you hit it, you are Befuddled for 15 s: forward, back, left and right are shuffled, and attack (break) swaps with use (place).$(br2)$(l)Accessory$(): Muddled Spiral, which wards this affix off.
$(l)Dropped material$()$(br2)$(o)A crystal that grows in a spiral. Stare at it long enough and left and right blur together.$()
